shorts.title: Pufferfish Poison Is Deadlier Than Cyanide 🐡
shorts.description:
Pufferfish poison: 1,000 times deadlier than cyanide. Tetrodotoxin blocks the sodium channels nerves use to fire.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Pufferfish: portioid (CC BY), Bill Levine (CC BY), Reizo Knapp (CC BY), Julien Renoult (CC BY), Piotr Lukasik (CC BY), Giancarlo (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: Would you ever try fugu? 👇

shorts.title: This Beetle Survives Being Run Over by a Car 🪲
shorts.description:
Ironclad beetles survive being run over. The diabolical ironclad beetle's wing cases lock together like jigsaw pieces.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Diabolical ironclad beetle: CC0, Tom and T Herman (CC BY), Nicole (CC BY), Hydrocycler (Elizabeth Dougherty) (CC BY), mel letterman (CC BY), Mark Valen (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0
shorts.comment: What would you want to be uncrushable? 👇

shorts.title: Stonefish Are the Most Venomous Fish, and They Look Like Rocks 🪨
shorts.description:
Stonefish are the most venomous fish known. First aid: get out of the water, soak in hot water (about 40-45 °C), get to hospital.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Reef stonefish: Roger Rittmaster (CC BY), Kai Squires (CC BY), unipon (CC BY), Matt Muir (CC BY), Tom Heijnen (CC BY), Robert Taylor (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: Moray Eels Have a Second Set of Jaws 🦷
shorts.description:
Moray eels have a second set of jaws. Mehta & Wainwright, Nature 2007: the first vertebrate known to use a second set of jaws to grab and move prey.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Moray eel: Dan Schofield (CC BY), Jared Shorma (CC BY), Pierre Pericard (CC BY), TonyT (CC BY), CC0. creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: House Flies Throw Up on Your Food 🪰
shorts.description:
House flies throw up on your food. Their mouthparts are a soft sponge; they can't bite.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Bombardier Beetles Fire Boiling Spray From Their Butts 💥
shorts.description:
Bombardier beetles fire boiling spray from their butts. The spray reaches about 100 °C, boiling-water hot.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Horned Lizards Squirt Blood From Their Eyes 🦎
shorts.description:
Horned lizards squirt blood from their eyes. The blood tastes foul to dogs, foxes and coyotes, but birds don't seem to mind it.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Texas horned lizard: Sam Kieschnick (CC BY), highsinger (CC BY), CC0, Andrew Meeds (CC BY), Luis F. shorts.title: Leeches Are an FDA-Cleared Medical Device 🩸
shorts.description:
Leeches are an FDA-cleared medical device. Hirudin, from leech saliva, stops blood from clotting.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Medicinal leech: Kate Senatskaya (CC BY), Andrew Bazdyrev (CC BY), Philip Schaffer (CC BY), ajott (CC BY), Claude Kolwelter (CC BY), Viktor Strenada (CC BY), Bartosz Czołczyński (CC BY), Patrick Schwager (CC BY). creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0 · creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0

shorts.title: This Dung Beetle Pulls 1,141 Times Its Own Weight 💪
shorts.description:
Dung beetles can pull 1,141 times their weight. Male bull-headed dung beetles use their horns to fight rivals inside tunnels.

shorts.title: Giant Water Bugs Turn Their Prey Into Soup 🥣
shorts.description:
Giant water bugs turn prey into soup. Some giant water bug fathers carry the eggs on their backs until they hatch.

shorts.title: Skunks Can Hit You From 10 Feet Away 🦨
shorts.description:
Skunks can spray you from 10 feet. A National Zoo biologist says skunks can hit a target up to 20 feet away.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: A Woodpecker's Tongue Wraps Around Its Skull 🐦
shorts.description:
Woodpecker tongues wrap around their skulls. The tongue sits on the hyoid, a set of bones and cartilage that loops over the head.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: This Songbird Hangs Its Food on Barbed Wire 🐦
shorts.description:
Shrikes hang their food on barbed wire. Loggerhead shrikes are songbirds with a hooked, hawk-like beak.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Sea Lampreys Drink Fish Blood 🩸
shorts.description:
Sea lampreys drink fish blood. A sea lamprey can kill up to 40 pounds of fish during its feeding stage.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Velvet Ants Aren't Ants. They're Wasps 🐜
shorts.description:
Velvet ants aren't ants. Velvet ants aren't aggressive; females sting only in defense.

shorts.title: Sea Cucumbers Breathe Through Their Butts 🥒
shorts.description:
Sea cucumbers breathe through their butts. Pearlfish live inside some sea cucumbers, slipping in through the rear.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Gila Monsters Chew Their Venom Into You 🦎
shorts.description:
Gila monsters chew their venom into you. Exenatide (Byetta), approved in 2005, is a synthetic copy of exendin-4 from Gila monster venom.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

Photos (iNaturalist), cropped and color-adjusted: Gila monster: Dan Vickers (CC BY), Melanie J. shorts.title: Turkey Vultures Throw Up on Anything That Scares Them 🤮
shorts.description:
Turkey vultures vomit on anything that scares them. Their strong stomach acid helps them eat carrion that could carry anthrax or botulism.

#shorts #animalfacts #meatballmyths

shorts.title: Bullet Ants Have the Most Painful Sting Ever Ranked 🐜
shorts.description:
Bullet ants have the most painful sting ranked. Bullet ant pain can come in waves for up to 24 hours.

shorts.title: Tarantula Hawks Are Wasps That Hunt Tarantulas 🕷️
